use_cases.title: Monitoring telemetry gap, parser failure or coverage loss
use_cases.description: Identify loss of required firewall, server, network-device or OT sensor evidence before dependent detections silently fail.
use_cases.logic: Evaluate expected heartbeat/event cadence, parser failure rates and required-field completeness by source; distinguish quiet assets from broken collectors.
use_cases.telemetry: SIEM ingestion/collector and sensor health; source_id, event/ingest time, expected cadence, parser errors, required field nulls, maintenance.
use_cases.exceptions: Planned quiet periods, sparse-event devices, maintenance and controlled ingestion changes.
use_cases.validation: Replay stopped collector, parser schema change and healthy low-volume source; mark dependent use cases visibility-degraded.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: Clock drift or unauthorized time-source change
use_cases.description: Identify clock offsets or time-configuration changes that undermine trustworthy SOE and security correlation.
use_cases.logic: Separate source clock drift, time-source policy change and decoded IEC-104 time/reset commands; compare trusted reference and configurable source tolerance, accounting for network/ingest delay.
use_cases.telemetry: Existing NTP/PTP/device/system time audit and passive protocol; source/event/ingest time, offset, time server, config actor, command/result.
use_cases.exceptions: Approved time-server maintenance, gateway translation, disconnected sites and daylight/timezone display differences.
use_cases.validation: Replay known offset, collector delay and approved time-source change; do not label drift as Rootkit or issue time-setting commands.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: Unapproved security posture or vulnerability exposure change
use_cases.description: Track newly relevant vulnerabilities, unsupported configurations and overdue approved remediation on known OT assets.
use_cases.logic: Join passive/approved inventory and version evidence with advisory applicability and site remediation plan; distinguish missing version data from proven vulnerable applicability.
use_cases.telemetry: Approved asset/software inventory, vendor advisories and change/risk register; model/version, applicability, compensating controls, owner, due date.
use_cases.exceptions: Accepted risk, OEM constraints, compensating controls and unavailable maintenance windows.
use_cases.validation: Test an applicable and nonapplicable advisory plus unknown version; use existing evidence rather than initiating an active scan.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: OT detection escalation or SOC evidence-transfer failure
use_cases.description: Identify an alert that cannot reach the designated SOC/plant owner or exceeds the agreed acknowledgement/escalation path.
use_cases.logic: Track alert handoff, owner resolution and acknowledgement against site-approved priority and escalation timers; detect broken forwarding and missing plant context.
use_cases.telemetry: SIEM/SOAR/ticket/forwarder health; alert_id, owner, route, delivery/ack status, clock, priority, asset/process context.
use_cases.exceptions: Approved exercises, planned SOC maintenance and documented alternate escalation.
use_cases.validation: Use a benign test alert to verify permitted one-way/brokered forwarding and acknowledgement. Do not create new OT connections or automated controller containment.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: Anonymous or first-seen access to an OT management service
use_cases.description: Identify an accepted anonymous session or new client to FTP, web or broker management services that conflicts with the target access policy.
use_cases.logic: Keep anonymous-identity and first-seen-client variants distinct; confirm target service, acceptance, granted rights and approved source. A new client is a baseline signal until policy violation is established.
use_cases.telemetry: Application authentication/session and device inventory; service, source, target, identity type, account if supplied, session, rights, outcome.
use_cases.exceptions: Approved anonymous read-only services, discovery endpoints and commissioning clients.
use_cases.validation: Replay approved read-only anonymous access and prohibited anonymous management access; do not infer external access from protocol alone.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: Confirmed use of manufacturer default credentials
use_cases.description: Identify successful credential use that device/application evidence confirms is a manufacturer default account.
use_cases.logic: Use approved account/configuration audit or credential-class evidence; do not collect passwords in the SIEM or infer default credentials from generic login failure. Distinguish default from hardcoded when known.
use_cases.telemetry: Device authentication/configuration audit and account inventory; account class, device/model, source, success/result, owner, approval.
use_cases.exceptions: Authorized initial commissioning and vendor-supported credential constraints with documented compensating controls.
use_cases.validation: Test verified default-account use, nondefault credentials and unsuccessful generic attempts. For hardcoded-only behavior select T1694.002 after confirming account class.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: High only for verified default-credential use
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: Unauthorized OT web-management control action after login
use_cases.description: Detect an authenticated OT web action that changes device configuration, starts/stops a device or initiates a programming operation outside authorization.
use_cases.logic: Join accepted login/session to an OEM-validated management endpoint and decoded action/result; choose a separate programming/mode/parameter use case when that specific action is confirmed.
use_cases.telemetry: Device web/application audit, session/authentication and approved API/endpoint map; session, target, endpoint, action, actor, result, approval.
use_cases.exceptions: Approved administration, diagnostics, vendor support and CSRF/background page behavior.
use_cases.validation: Replay mere page access, rejected action and unapproved successful management change; an HTTP path alone must not establish control effect.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: High if the specified behavior is evidenced
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

technique_details.confidence: High if the specified behavior is evidenced

use_cases.title: Unauthorized S7 variable write to a protected address
use_cases.description: Identify a decoded S7 variable write from a source not authorized for the target controller, memory area or control variable.
use_cases.logic: Compare Write Var requests and responses with source-target-address/function policy and validated symbol/address map. Separate data writes from block downloads and CPU mode commands.
use_cases.telemetry: Passive S7 decoder and engineering audit; requester, controller, area/DB/address, data type/value, transaction, item result, approved symbol map.
use_cases.exceptions: Normal HMI/SCADA writes, approved engineering, recipes and supported redundancy.
use_cases.validation: Replay approved writes, unauthorized accepted write and rejected item result; add Modify Parameter only when the address is confirmed as a parameter.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: High if the specified behavior is evidenced
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

technique_details.name: Command Message
technique_details.confidence: High if the specified behavior is evidenced

use_cases.title: Unapproved CIP connection establishment
use_cases.description: Identify a decoded CIP connection request or accepted connection outside the approved controller/client pairing and connection scope.
use_cases.logic: Evaluate Forward Open source, target, connection path and response against configured I/O/engineering relationships. Classify connection establishment separately from writes and process effects.
use_cases.telemetry: Passive CIP decoder and controller configuration; client, target, service, connection path/type, response, approved relationship.
use_cases.exceptions: Authorized cyclic I/O connections, reconnection, redundant controllers and engineering diagnostics.
use_cases.validation: Replay routine connection re-establishment and unapproved accepted connection; no command-write or parameter-change claim without a decoded subsequent action.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

use_cases.title: Control command outside approved HMI-to-controller pairing
use_cases.description: Identify an HMI or supervisory host issuing a control command to a controller or point outside its authorized operating scope.
use_cases.logic: Decode command and compare source role, target, point and permitted action against the pairing map; retain response/outcome. Cross-cell communication alone is not enough.
use_cases.telemetry: Passive control-protocol and SCADA audit; source HMI, controller, operation, point/address, value, result, pairing approval.
use_cases.exceptions: Approved shared HMIs, backup control rooms, cross-cell interlocks and emergency operations.
use_cases.validation: Replay authorized shared-HMI operation and an unauthorized decoded command; do not infer lateral tool transfer from control traffic.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: High if the specified behavior is evidenced
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated

technique_details.confidence: High if the specified behavior is evidenced

use_cases.title: Unapproved file placement on an OT controller or gateway
use_cases.description: Identify files transferred to a controller or gateway outside the source, path, file-class and operation authorization.
use_cases.logic: Correlate decoded FTP/STOR or supported device file-transfer audit with source authorization and final result; preserve file identity. Treat subsequent program install or firmware flash as separate evidence.
use_cases.telemetry: Device file-transfer audit, approved passive decoder and package repository; source, target, path, operation, hash/class if available, result, approval.
use_cases.exceptions: Approved firmware staging, log retrieval, backups, vendor diagnostics and recovery.
use_cases.validation: Replay approved staging, rejected placement and unapproved successful placement; extensions alone must not imply firmware modification or project infection.
use_cases.mapping_confidence: Unmapped: anomaly, posture, or separate Enterprise verification required
use_cases.status: Proposed — not implemented or site validated
